title: Condition-blind mixed-channel learned addressing without isotropic collapse
question: Can a condition-blind learned associative key scorer regain isotropic raw-dot calibration and retain positive structured-channel gain when trained on a fixed mixed-corruption stream?
hypothesis: A fixed 50:50 isotropic/structured training mixture can keep mean isotropic learned-minus-raw accuracy >=-0.02 and structured high-noise M32 gain >=+0.03 without an inference-time channel identifier.
relation_to_prior: New follow-up to TACOSM-PLM-LEARNED-ADDRESS-002, whose measured structured-only scorer failed isotropic noninferiority; no changes to earlier contract or result.

protocol.training_channel_schedule: structured-only arm structured every step; mixed arm alternates structured (even steps) and isotropic (odd steps); sigma=.2 for steps%4 in [0,1] else .4
protocol.initialization: both learned scorers independently initialized identically via the same torch seed: 16D bilinear identity query/key and zero-output candidate-key bias
protocol.architecture: frozen LearnedAddressMetric002, no model changes, no channel label, no raw-dot bypass
protocol.raw_dot_reference: rank cosine-normalized query versus unit keys with dot product

benchmark.generator_semantics: unchanged from 002; held-out RNG namespace differs from 002

arms.name: structured_only
arms.intervention: original 002 architecture, 750 training steps on structured channel at sigma=.2,.4 only; retrained for each seed

arms.name: mixed_unlabeled
arms.intervention: identical architecture, seed, steps, optimizer, batch budget, 50:50 structured/isotropic training with no channel indicator to scorer

arms.name: raw_dot
arms.intervention: untrained dot-product Bayes reference evaluated on identical keys/queries for each condition

arms.name: oracle_target_key
arms.intervention: evaluate the correctly selected key as an exact query for both learned models; no oracle during training

arms.name: wrong_key_query
arms.intervention: query equals a non-target stored key, evaluation-only corrupted-query control for both models

arms.name: slot_permutation
arms.intervention: permute stored key positions and corresponding labels, evaluate both learned scorers

decision_rule.condition: All integrity gates hold; mixed_unlabeled mean isotropic learned-minus-raw accuracy across full registered grid >= -0.02 AND structured-channel high noise mean learned-minus-raw at M32 over sigma .2,.4 >=+0.03
decision_rule.licenses: Bounded positive evidence that this fixed condition-blind scorer can trade a single fixed mixed training stream for calibration on isotropic and better-than-raw addressing on the registered structured channel.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Bayes optimality, semantic addressing, dynamic channel recognition, generalization to arbitrary corruption, semantic PLM persistence or sublinear retrieval.

decision_rule.condition: Integrity passes but either mixed-unlabeled primary criterion fails
decision_rule.licenses: The registered mixed-training hypothesis is not established. Report the negative arm without post-run tuning.

decision_rule.condition: Any missing arm, benchmark hash/contract mismatch, channel leakage, evaluation fingerprint mismatch, missing control, or parameter-change gate fails
decision_rule.licenses: Instrument-invalid; no positive or negative learned-address conclusion from that artifact.

held_constant: Same frozen 002 scorer class for structured-only and mixed; no additional parameters
Exact same held-out evaluation keys/query/target/payload per seed/condition across all arms
Every seed uses equal 750-step, 512-example AdamW training budget
Fixed chronological alternating training channel mixture; no label at prediction
Ten seeds and full 7-M by 6-isotropic/5-structured sigma grid; 10000 evaluation trials per cell
No checkpoint selection, threshold changes or evaluation-informed tuning
Uniform random targets, independent payload, 002 structured diagonal unchanged
interpretation_order: Baseline and model identity, premeasurement contract provenance
Identical held-out evaluation fingerprints between both learned arms and raw
Trained parameter change, absence of corruption label, capacity/slot controls
Full conditioned curves and structured-only comparator
Joint preregistered criterion and claim boundary
claim_boundary: No semantic retrieval, multimodal reasoning, real-world memory or C5 claim
Failure in any joint primary criterion is a failed registered mechanism gate
